subject: note:propria_design_contract_relocation_20260912
title: Shared design contract moved under Propria resources
summary: Verified 2026-09-12: the 14-file Propria design-contract package moved from the root-level design-contract directory to canonical resources/design. Root contract links and the monorepo manifest now use resources/design. A Windows junction remains at design-contract and targets resources/design for compatibility with active sessions and historical local paths. The package verifier was run from the canonical path. No content was deleted; this finding does not approve the proposed palette or claim application adoption. SUPERSEDED 2026-09-18 (owner: Propria is the project): moved back to root design-contract/ with git mv; resources/ retired.
rationale: This records the first verified physical move in the owner-directed Propria monorepo migration while keeping design approval distinct from repository topology.
